subject: Scientific buoy - East Coast
text:
Scientific buoy - East Coast
Scientific weather buoy deployed in vicinity of 47 23.475N 053 07.950W
Buoy is yellow in colour. Superstructure is 3.5 metres above sea level, and 3.0 metres below.
Buoy is equipped with a radar reflector and a yellow obstruction light Flash (5)20s.
